_comment: Labelled corpus for eval/run_eval.py. 'dataset' paths are relative to a checkout of github.com/DataDog/malicious-software-packages-dataset (fetch with eval/fetch_malicious.sh). Clean targets are fetched from public registries. 'split': rules were tuned on 'dev'; report 'holdout' for an honest estimate. 'set': 'random-2026-11' marks clean packages drawn at random from npm and PyPI (eval/sample_clean.py) instead of picked. 'set': 'tune-2026-11' marks malicious samples drawn for tuning (split dev): every 2026 PyPI package not used before, 19 from 2025, 40 npm from 2026.
